name: Bus ETA
summary: Live bus arrivals with on-device station setup and low-power sleep.
description: Bus ETA turns reTerminal Sticky into a live bus arrival display. It supports Singapore and Hong Kong bus data, station name or ID setup, configurable refresh intervals, WiFi setup, NTP and RTC clock sync, and automatic low-power sleep. WiFi and station details are configured on the device after flashing.

compatibility.notes: Tested on reTerminal Sticky with ESP32-S3 using ESP-IDF v5.4. Configure WiFi and bus stop on the device after flashing.

assets.previewAlt: Bus ETA showing live bus arrivals on reTerminal Sticky

notes.title: Configure after flashing
notes.description: Use the device WiFi page to connect to WiFi, then use Setup to choose the city, station and refresh interval.

notes.title: Wake from sleep
notes.description: After one hour without hardware button activity, the device enters low-power sleep. Press the refresh/AI button to wake and refresh the Bus page.
